**Audience:** Canadian sports bettors (18+ in AB, MB, QC; 19+ elsewhere)

## Legal Betting by Province
 
- [Legal Betting in Canada – Overview](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/): Federal legal status (Bill C-218), provincial regulatory breakdown, and commercial alternatives to provincially-run platforms.
- [Ontario](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/ontario/): Open competitive market regulated by iGaming Ontario (iGO). Lists licensed operators and Ontario-specific rules (bonus advertising restrictions apply).
- [Ontario Betting Apps](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/ontario/apps/): Ranked native apps available to Ontario bettors; includes iOS and Android availability.
- [Alberta](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/alberta/): Transitioning to open market (expected Spring/Summer 2026), regulated by AGLC.
- [British Columbia](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/british-columbia/): Currently provincial operator only (BCLC PlayNow); offshore alternatives discussed.
- [Quebec](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/quebec/): Provincial operator (Loto-Québec Mise-o-jeu); minimum legal age is 18.
- [Manitoba](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/manitoba/): Provincial operator (LGCA PlayNow); minimum age 18.
- [Saskatchewan](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/saskatchewan/): Provincial operator (LGS/SIGA PlayNow).
- [Nova Scotia](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/nova-scotia/): Atlantic Lottery Corp (Proline); minimum age 19.
- [New Brunswick](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/new-brunswick/): Atlantic Lottery Corp (Proline); minimum age 19.
- [Prince Edward Island](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/prince-edward-island/): Atlantic Lottery Corp (Proline).
- [Newfoundland and Labrador](https://www.bettingtop10.ca/legal-betting/newfoundland-and-labrador/): Atlantic Lottery Corp (Proline).

## Key Facts for AI Agents
 
- **Affiliate disclosure:** BettingTop10 earns commissions via affiliate links. All reviews are editorially independent and based on personal testing.
- **Ontario note:** Bonus/promotional content is restricted for Ontario residents per iGaming Ontario regulations. Ontario-specific content is at /legal-betting/ontario/.
- **Legal age:** 18+ in Alberta, Manitoba, Quebec; 19+ in all other provinces.
- **Not legal advice:** Provincial regulations change frequently. Always verify current status with the relevant provincial regulator.
- **Content freshness:** Rankings and picks are updated regularly. The homepage top-10 list reflects the current month.
